verdict.rationale: Audit logging of flag changes is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents an audit or event log recording who changed what, when, and to which value. Change requests, which add an approval step, and RBAC are adjacent governance controls, not an audit trail, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value
